_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-05-12 09:21:40Z)**_

`git push` was rejected because `origin/main` has commits your local `main` does not. Git prevents a non-fast-forward push so you don’t overwrite remote history by accident.

Use the safe fix if you want to keep the remote commits:

```bash
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
git push origin main
```

If the rebase hits conflicts, resolve them, then run `git rebase --continue` and push again.

Only if you intentionally want to replace the remote branch with your local history, use:

```bash
git push --force-with-lease origin main
```

Prefer `--force-with-lease`, not plain `--force`.
